blocks.text: Bacteria bohat aham jandar hain, na sirf mahol (environment) ke liye balke baqi tamam jandaron ke liye bhi. Zameen par zindagi par in ke faidemand (beneficial) aur nuqsan-deh (harmful) dono asraat hain. Bacteria ke bare tanawwo (diversity) mein bohat se ecological aur maashi (economic) tor par faidemand hain. Kitaab in faidon ko paanch unwaanon (headings) mein rakhti hai.

Bacteria taqreeban tamam biogeochemical cycles mein hissa lete hain, jin mein zaroori anasir (elements) jandaron aur mahol ke darmiyan aate jaate hain. Nitrifying bacteria (Nitrosomonas, Nitrobacter aur Azotobacter) aur denitrifying bacteria (Pseudomonas) nitrogen cycle mukammal karne mein aham kirdar ada karte hain. Decomposer bacteria murda organic madde ko torte hain aur carbon-hydrogen-oxygen cycle mein kaleedi (key) kirdar rakhte hain. Photosynthetic bacteria, jaise cyanobacteria, ki sargarmiyan zameen ki fiza mein azaad oxygen barhati hain.

Bohat se bacteria, maslan Lactobacillus yeasts aur moulds ke saath mil kar, hazaron saalon se khameer shuda (fermented) khoraak banane mein istemal hote hain, jaise cheese, achar (pickles), soy sauce, sirka (vinegar), wine aur yogurt. Pharmaceutical aur agrochemical industries mein bacteria aham chemicals banane ke liye sab se zyada aham hain, aur kuch bacteria antibiotics banane mein istemal hote hain. Chamre (leather) ki cheezon ke liye janwaron ki khaal ki tijarti tayyari mein bhi bacteria ka istemal hota hai.

Bohat se bacteria organic compounds ko bohat aasani se tor dete hain, is liye unhen mahol se aaloodgi (pollutants) hatane ya torne ke liye istemal kiya jata hai; is amal ko bioremediation kehte hain. Maslan, bacteria shehr ke sewage ko be-zarar cheezon mein tor dete hain. Kuch bacteria petroleum ke hydrocarbons hazam kar sakte hain aur oil spills saaf karne mein istemal hote hain. Bacteria sanati (industrial) zehreelay fuzle (waste) ki bioremediation mein bhi istemal hote hain.

Biological pest control mein kimiyai pesticides ki jagah bacteria istemal hote hain. Is mein aam tor par Bacillus thuringiensis shamil hai, ek Gram-positive, mitti mein rehne wala bacterium. Aise biopesticides mahol dost hain aur insaanon, jangli hayat, pollinators aur aksar doosre faidemand keeron par bohat kam ya koi asar nahin karte.

Bacteria tezi se barhte hain aur scientists unhen bohat aasani se badal (manipulate kar) sakte hain, is liye yeh molecular biology, genetics aur biochemistry mein istemal hote hain. Scientists bacterial DNA mein mutations karte hain aur khususiyat (characteristics) mein tabdeeli (change) dekhte hain; is tarah woh bacteria mein genes aur enzymes ka kaam maloom karte hain, aur phir yeh ilm zyada pecheeda (complex) jandaron ke wohi genes aur enzymes samajhne mein lagate hain. Scientists bacteria mein insaani genes daal kar ilaaj ke proteins bhi banate hain, jaise insulin, growth hormones aur antibodies.

blocks.title: Bioremediation
blocks.text: Zinda jandaron, yahan bacteria, ka istemal mahol se aaloodgi hatane ya torne ke liye.

blocks.prompt: Bacteria research ke itne mufeed auzaar kyun hain, aur bacteria mein insaani gene daal kar kaunsi ek tibbi (medical) cheez banti hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh tezi se barhte hain aur aasani se badle ja sakte hain, is liye mutations kar ke genes aur enzymes ka kaam samjha ja sakta hai. Bacteria mein daale gaye insaani genes se ilaaj ke proteins bante hain jaise insulin, growth hormones ya antibodies.

items: Bacteria anasir recycle karte hain: nitrifying aur denitrifying bacteria nitrogen cycle mukammal karte hain, decomposers carbon-hydrogen-oxygen cycle chalate hain, cyanobacteria oxygen barhate hain.
Yeh khameer shuda khoraak, chemicals, antibiotics banate hain aur chamre ki tayyari mein madad dete hain.
Yeh sewage, oil spills aur zehreelay fuzle ki bioremediation se mahol saaf karte hain.
Yeh molecular biology, genetics aur biochemistry ke auzaar hain, aur ilaaj ke proteins ki factory.
